decision.reason: [ev-23473218087f] is one upgrade-note sentence covering several changes: Cassandra L7 policy support is deprecated, Memcached L7 policy support is deprecated, and the getting-started guides are removed. It does not say how these policies are expressed (for example, which policy field or protocol value), so it gives no basis for an applicability condition. It also does not say whether the features still work in 1.17.0 or when they will be removed, so the consequence of doing nothing is unknown. We need the evidence split per protocol, plus the deprecation details (affected policy fields, current behaviour, removal plan) from the linked PR or the deprecation docs.
